answer: An agent’s influence can depend on reputation earned by completing tasks that independent peers verify, not on how many accounts it creates. Lock rewards until verification and revoke them if audits prove fraud. A sybil attacker must fund each identity and wait to build a credible record; splitting effort across accounts does not multiply trusted weight. The ledge is colluding reviewers, so audits need diverse peers. A glacier-like delay raises attack costs; jade badges alone prove nothing.
